title: calyptrochilum christyanum
intro: Calyptrochilum christyanum, commonly known as the 'Queen of the Night', is a species of flowering plant in the orchid family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, that may aid in relieving pain, reducing fever, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Calyptrochilum christyanum are attributed to its ability to modulate the nervous system, promoting relaxation and reducing anxiety. Bioactive constituents of the plant, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, have been identified as responsible for its medicinal properties.
